answer: The protocol requires 1,000 unique credential nullifiers to authorize each autonomous AI agent, ensuring repair tasks remain distinct across the fleet. An honest agent pays 1,000 units to register, while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000,000 units to bypass this gate. The verifier scans the repository to forge an audit path, using a mirror of historical task signatures to detect any collision. This acts as a gale against Sybil growth, where any reused identity or duplicated repair output triggers an immediate, permanent, and non-refundable lockout to maintain strict integrity.
